content: I think this is a relatively new feature, but github releases now show download counts per-artifact which is kind of neat

not exactly representative for wasmtime since a lot of usage is expected to come through crates.io as well, but at least somewhat of a signal of used platforms. Not exactly surprising that linux has the highest download counts followed by macos followed by windows though
Looks like it is only visible to maintainers.
They seemingly did retroactively populate this field for old releases.
